tasks.short: Plan carpet layouts for appearance and wear.

steps.what: Inspect actual room geometry, carpet constraints and expected traffic patterns
inputs: actual selected carpet width and pattern
outputs: actual room and carpet layout constraints

steps.what: Plan carpet layout and place seams for best appearance and longest wear
inputs: actual room and carpet layout constraints
actual expected traffic and visible sightlines
outputs: actual chosen carpet direction and seam positions

steps.what: Draw the chosen carpet layout in the floor-planning tool {OTHER}
inputs: actual chosen carpet direction and seam positions

steps.what: Check the final layout against actual traffic, seam positions and carpet constraints
inputs: actual room and carpet layout constraints

steps.what: Save the checked final carpet layout

tasks.design: Configure native room-geometry reuse and carpet-width drawing aids in the floor-planning tool {OTHER}. The installer assesses traffic and appearance, chooses seams and checks the final drawing before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Layout drawing can repeat already measured geometry and selected carpet dimensions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geometry reuse can reduce repeated drawing after the installer chooses the layout.
tasks.still_hard: Seam visibility, wear, irregular rooms and actual installation constraints require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The installer understands how the room will be used and how the carpet will look on site.
tasks.altitude: Less drawing repetition; layout choices remain with the installer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: floor-planning tools can reuse geometry and material widths; they do not determine best seam appearance or actual wear.

assumptions: Actual measurement owner supplies verified room dimensions and units; installer checks actual site and selected carpet width/pattern in s1, chooses direction/seams in s2 and captures unsupported geometry in retained s3.
No free survey or invented digital floor plan is assumed. If geometry is not already usable, its capture remains in retained work and eligibility falls.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native drawing aids first; existing automatic drawing earns zero saving. Save retains one percent and uses the existing final check.
Any customer send, material order or installation is outside this planning boundary, requires its own actual authorisation and earns no saving here.
unknowns: Is a reusable measured floor plan actually available?
research_questions: Does native geometry reuse reduce drawing time after checking seam placement?

incremental.description: Maintain actual carpet-width and drawing templates.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final carpet layout and exact job destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30*0.40 drawing = 12; minus 1 upkeep = 11. Half eligible gives 6 minus 1 = 5. Site assessment, seam choice, final check and save stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure floors and calculate carpet area and material needs.

steps.what: Take measurements of actual floor dimensions, recesses and openings
Study floor sketches and choose actual carpet width, pattern and waste allowances
outputs: checked geometry and chosen material calculation inputs

steps.what: Calculate area to be carpeted and amount of material needed
inputs: checked geometry and chosen material calculation inputs
outputs: calculated actual floor area and carpet quantity draft

steps.what: Check final floor area and carpet quantity against actual measurements and layout
inputs: calculated actual floor area and carpet quantity draft
outputs: checked final area and material quantity record

steps.what: Save the checked final area and material quantity record
inputs: checked final area and material quantity record

tasks.design: Configure native area and quantity calculations in the floor takeoff tool {OTHER}. The installer measures, studies the floor sketch, supplies actual material constraints and checks the final quantities before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material takeoff can repeat arithmetic from measured geometry and chosen allowances.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed native geometry and quantity formulas can perform that arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Irregular geometry, pattern repeats and usable roll layout require actual interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The installer recognises when an area figure understates the carpet actually needed.
tasks.altitude: Less takeoff arithmetic; measurement and material judgement stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native floor takeoff functions can calculate areas and quantities from verified geometry and chosen allowances; they do not provide free measurements or guarantee a usable carpet layout.

assumptions: Installer creates actual measured dimensions in s1 and captures/verifies geometry, units, roll width, pattern repeat and chosen allowances in retained s2. Unsupported geometry stays manual; no digital survey or automatic interpretation is assumed.
Native formula is checked against actual layout in s4. Only repeated arithmetic is removed; already automatic takeoff and runtime earn zero saving.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Save remains one percent and uses the existing final quantity check. Any actual purchase is a separate gated action with no saving claimed here.
unknowns: Can the native tool represent actual irregular rooms and pattern rules?
research_questions: Do native calculations reduce arithmetic after full measurement and layout checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual material rules and quantity formulas.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final area and material quantity record and exact job destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25 arithmetic; minus 1 upkeep = 24. Half eligible gives 12.5 minus 1 = 11.5. Measurement, interpretation, final check and save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw building diagrams and record dimensions.

steps.what: Observe actual building geometry and measure dimensions for the diagram
outputs: actual observed geometry and measured dimensions

steps.what: Record dimensions and units in the floor-planning tool {OTHER}
inputs: actual observed geometry and measured dimensions

steps.what: Draw building diagrams from the checked actual dimensions
inputs: actual observed geometry and measured dimensions

steps.what: Check final building diagram, dimensions, units and actual room correspondence
inputs: actual observed geometry and measured dimensions

steps.what: Save the checked final dimensioned building diagram

tasks.design: Configure native dimension fields and linked drawing annotations in the floor-planning tool {OTHER}. The installer captures actual geometry once, checks the generated diagram and separately saves the final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dimensioned diagrams can repeat the same measurements in labels and geometry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dimension-driven drawing and annotations can reduce repeated entry and redraws.
tasks.still_hard: Real room shape and reliable measurements require on-site work.
tasks.human_edge: The installer spots a neat diagram that does not match the building.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated dimension entry and drawing; survey judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native dimension-linked drawing functions can reuse entered dimensions in diagrams; they do not supply actual building measurements.

assumptions: Installer creates actual measurements in s1 and enters/verifies primary dimension, unit and room fields in retained s2. Cuts cover repeated labels/references, not first capture; no laser import or free paper digitisation is assumed.
S3 uses checked fields for drawing but retains irregular-shape edits and interpretation. Existing dimension-driven drawing earns zero saving.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Save retains one percent and uses the existing final diagram check, adding no self-approval time.
When this diagram also supplies another task, count its capture and upkeep only once in any combined estimate.
unknowns: How often are dimensions repeated in labels?
Is native dimension-driven drawing already used?
research_questions: Can native linked annotations reduce redraws without changing measurement checks?

incremental.description: Maintain dimension and drawing annotation settings.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final dimensioned building diagram and exact job destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 repeated fields + 30*0.40 drawing = 18; minus 1 upkeep = 17. Half eligible gives 9 minus 1 = 8. Actual measurement, final check and save stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Installers keep physical measurement, site interpretation and seam choices while native drawing and takeoff functions may reduce repeated work.
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual repeated drawing and arithmetic, counting shared measurement work once.
